answer: In an AI agent economy Sybil resistance works by forcing every participant to post a slashable bond on a shared terrace of the ledger. The required bond scales with the privileges an agent claims so that creating many fake identities forces the attacker to lock capital across each one. When peers detect coordinated fakes the bonds are burned driving the attacker’s usable funds to their nadir while honest agents keep a stable ledge of committed value that makes large-scale identity farming economically irrational.
